purpose: Independent 100-subject Career replication set for the frozen V3 TENGOD_ONLY architecture.
core_rule: Y is real-world life events only; saju/model outputs were forbidden during subject and event curation.

selection_policy.birth: Rodden AA public birth records via VedAstro; 1900+ only for current sajupy engine compatibility.
selection_policy.event_design: Exactly one Career-positive and one Career-negative year per subject to equalize subject weight and avoid forcing ambiguous extra events.
selection_policy.event_priority: Prefer objective career outcomes: titles/awards/elections/appointments versus losses/firings/injuries/cancellations/sanctions.
selection_policy.model_blinding: No frozen TENGOD score or any saju-derived feature was inspected to select subjects or event years.
selection_policy.event_source_status: Single-source public-biography curation. Every event is flagged needs_secondary_verification=true before paper-grade claims.
